title: HTTP Client Snippet Generator
description: Turn a method, URL, headers and body into fetch, axios, cURL and Python requests snippets.
howto: Pick the method and enter the URL.
Add headers (one "Key: value" per line) and a body.
Switch tabs to see fetch, axios, cURL and Python versions.
Copy any snippet or download them all.

faqs.q: Is the body sent as JSON?
faqs.a: If the body parses as JSON it is embedded as a JSON string in each snippet; otherwise it is sent as raw text.
One per line as "Name: value". Lines without a colon are ignored.
Yes — paste the fetch/axios snippet in JS, run the cURL command in a terminal, or run the Python snippet with the requests package installed.

faqs.q: Is anything sent to a server?
faqs.a: No — this only generates code. Nothing is executed or transmitted.
